verdict.rationale: Several install paths could be run by an agent. For Codex and OpenCode, a community report says you tell the agent to fetch and follow a raw GitHub INSTALL.md, so the agent performs the install itself (comm-5). Devin CLI has a single shell command, `devin plugins install obra/superpowers`, and Hermes installs from a git clone. The Claude Code path, however, relies on in-session `/plugin` slash commands, and installation differs per harness. missing for 10: documented promptless/non-interactive flags, explicit confirmation that agent-driven installs complete headlessly end to end without human approval, a unified scripted install across harnesses, independent hands-on verification of unattended installs.
